title: Source-Free Domain Adaptation by Optimizing Batch-Wise Cosine Similarity
summary: Source-Free Domain Adaptation (SFDA) is an emerging area of research that aims to adapt a model trained on a labeled source domain to an unlabeled target domain without accessing the source data. Most of the successful methods in this area rely on the concept of neighborhood consistency but are prone to errors due to misleading neighborhood information. In this paper, we explore this approach from the point of view of learning more informative clusters and mitigating the effect of noisy neighbors using a concept called neighborhood signature, and demonstrate that adaptation can be achieved using just a single loss term tailored to optimize the similarity and dissimilarity of predictions of samples in the target domain. In particular, our proposed method outperforms existing methods in the challenging VisDA dataset while also yielding competitive results on other benchmark datasets.

AI.title_translation: 通过优化批次内余弦相似度的源无关域适应
AI.tldr: 为了解决现有SFDA方法依赖邻域一致性易出错的问题，本文提出了一种基于“邻域签名”的新方法，该方法通过优化目标域样本预测的批次内余弦相似度和不相似性，仅用一个损失项就实现了比现有方法更优越的域适应性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的源无关域适应（SFDA）方法大多依赖于邻域一致性，但容易因误导性的邻域信息而产生错误。
AI.method: 通过“邻域签名”的概念，探索学习更具信息量的聚类并减轻噪声邻居的影响，并设计了一个单一的损失项来优化目标域中样本预测的相似性和不相似性。
AI.result: 所提出的方法在具有挑战性的VisDA数据集上优于现有方法，并在其他基准数据集上也取得了具有竞争力的结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过一个专门用于优化目标域中样本预测的相似性和不相似性的单一损失项，实现了源无关域适应，并且在VisDA数据集上表现优于现有方法。
AI.translation: 源无关域适应（SFDA）是一个新兴的研究领域，旨在将在一个有标签的源域上训练的模型适应到一个无标签的目标域，而无需访问源数据。该领域大多数成功的方法都依赖于邻域一致性的概念，但容易因误导性的邻域信息而产生错误。在本文中，我们从学习更有信息量的聚类和减轻噪声邻居影响的角度探索了这种方法，提出了“邻域签名”的概念，并证明仅使用一个专门用于优化目标域中样本预测的相似性和不相似性的损失项就可以实现适应。特别地，我们提出的方法在具有挑战性的VisDA数据集上优于现有方法，同时在其他基准数据集上也取得了具有竞争力的结果。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种新的源无关域适应（SFDA）方法，通过引入“邻域签名”的概念来解决现有方法中由噪声邻域信息导致的错误问题，并仅使用一个损失项来优化目标域样本预测的批次内余弦相似度，从而实现有效的域适应。
AI.keywords: 源无关域适应, 邻域一致性, 邻域签名, 批次内余弦相似度优化, 目标域
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了“邻域签名”的概念来优化目标域中样本预测的相似性和不相似性，并仅用一个损失项实现适应，这与依赖邻域一致性的现有方法形成对比。其重要性在于解决了现有方法中由误导性邻域信息导致的错误问题。限制是仅基于标题和摘要，无法评估其实际性能的深度。

title: DiffusionCinema: Text-to-Aerial Cinematography
summary: We propose a novel Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAV) assisted creative capture system that leverages diffusion models to interpret high-level natural language prompts and automatically generate optimal flight trajectories for cinematic video recording. Instead of manually piloting the drone, the user simply describes the desired shot (e.g., "orbit around me slowly from the right and reveal the background waterfall"). Our system encodes the prompt along with an initial visual snapshot from the onboard camera, and a diffusion model samples plausible spatio-temporal motion plans that satisfy both the scene geometry and shot semantics. The generated flight trajectory is then executed autonomously by the UAV to record smooth, repeatable video clips that match the prompt. User evaluation using NASA-TLX showed a significantly lower overall workload with our interface (M = 21.6) compared to a traditional remote controller (M = 58.1), demonstrating a substantial reduction in perceived effort. Mental demand (M = 11.5 vs. 60.5) and frustration (M = 14.0 vs. 54.5) were also markedly lower for our system, confirming clear usability advantages in autonomous text-driven flight control. This project demonstrates a new interaction paradigm: text-to-cinema flight, where diffusion models act as the "creative operator" converting story intentions directly into aerial motion.

AI.tldr: 该系统利用扩散模型根据自然语言提示自动生成无人机航拍轨迹，用户只需描述想要的镜头，系统即可自主完成拍摄，大大降低了操作难度和用户负担。
AI.motivation: 手动操控无人机进行电影化录制操作复杂且耗时，用户希望有一种更简单的方式来描述和实现期望的镜头。
AI.method: 系统编码用户输入的镜头描述（自然语言提示）和无人机 onboard 摄像头的初始视觉快照，然后利用扩散模型生成满足场景几何和镜头语义的可行时空运动规划。生成的飞行轨迹由无人机自主执行，以录制与提示相符的平滑、可重复的视频片段。
AI.result: 用户评估显示，与传统遥控器相比，该系统的整体工作负荷（平均值 21.6 vs. 58.1）、精神需求（平均值 11.5 vs. 60.5）和挫败感（平均值 14.0 vs. 54.5）显著降低，证明了其在自主文本驱动飞行控制方面的可用性优势。
AI.conclusion: 该研究展示了一种新的交互范式：文本到电影飞行。扩散模型充当“创意操作员”，将故事意图直接转化为航拍运动，显著降低了无人机电影化拍摄的操作门槛和用户感知的工作负荷。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一个新颖的无人机（UAV）辅助创意捕捉系统，该系统利用扩散模型来解释高级自然语言提示，并自动生成电影化视频录制的最佳飞行轨迹。用户无需手动操控无人机，只需描述所需的镜头（例如，“从右侧缓慢绕着我转，展示后面的瀑布”）。我们的系统将提示与来自机载摄像头的初始视觉快照一起编码，扩散模型对满足场景几何和镜头语义的可行时空运动计划进行采样。然后，无人机自主执行生成的飞行轨迹，以录制与提示相符的平滑、可重复的视频片段。用户评估使用 NASA-TLX 显示，与传统的遥控器（M = 58.1）相比，我们的界面（M = 21.6）整体工作负荷显著降低，证明了感知努力的实质性减少。与我们的系统相比，精神需求（M = 11.5 vs. 60.5）和挫败感（M = 14.0 vs. 54.5）也明显降低，证实了在自主文本驱动飞行控制方面具有明显的可用性优势。该项目展示了一种新的交互范式：文本到电影飞行，其中扩散模型充当“创意操作员”，将故事意图直接转化为航空运动。
AI.summary: DiffusionCinema 系统通过利用扩散模型，实现了从自然语言描述到无人机电影化航拍轨迹的自动生成。用户只需输入文本提示，系统即可自主规划并执行飞行路径，完成高质量的视频拍摄，极大地简化了操作流程并提升了用户体验。
AI.keywords: 扩散模型, 航拍摄影, 无人机, 文本到图像, 交互系统
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的文本到航拍摄影方法，利用扩散模型实现了无人机飞行的自动化和智能化。其主要贡献在于将自然语言指令转化为具体的飞行轨迹，降低了专业技能的要求，并显著提升了用户体验。然而，该方法在复杂环境下的鲁棒性、对动态场景的适应性以及生成轨迹的创造性上限仍有待进一步探索。

title: When AI Agents Touch CI/CD Configurations: Frequency and Success
comments: Accepted at the 23rd International Conference on Mining Software Repositories (MSR '26)
summary: AI agents are increasingly used in software development, yet their interaction with CI/CD configurations is not well studied. We analyze 8,031 agentic pull requests (PRs) from 1,605 GitHub repositories where AI agents touch YAML configurations. CI/CD configuration files account for 3.25% of agent changes, varying by agent (Devin: 4.83%, Codex: 2.01%, p < 0.001). When agents modify CI/CD, 96.77% target GitHub Actions. Agentic PRs with CI/CD changes merge slightly less often than others (67.77% vs. 71.80%), except for Copilot, whose CI/CD changes merge 15.63 percentage points more often. Across 99,930 workflow runs, build success rates are comparable for CI/CD and non-CI/CD changes (75.59% vs. 74.87%), though three agents show significantly higher success when modifying CI/CD. These results show that AI agents rarely modify CI/CD and focus mostly on GitHub Actions, yet their configuration changes are as reliable as regular code. Copilot's strong CI/CD performance despite lower acceptance suggests emerging configuration specialization, with implications for agent training and DevOps automation.
comment: Accepted at the 23rd International Conference on Mining Software Repositories (MSR '26)

title: Cloud-Enabled IoT System for Real-Time Environmental Monitoring and Remote Device Control Using Firebase
authors: A. S. M. Ahsanul Sarkar Akib
summary: The proliferation of Internet of Things (IoT) devices has created unprecedented opportunities for remote monitoring and control applications across various domains. Traditional monitoring systems often suffer from limitations in real-time data accessibility, remote controllability, and cloud integration. This paper presents a cloud-enabled IoT system that leverages Google's Firebase Realtime Database for synchronized environmental monitoring and device control. The system utilizes an ESP32 microcontroller to interface with a DHT22 temperature/humidity sensor and an HC-SR04 ultrasonic distance sensor, while enabling remote control of two LED indicators through a cloud-based interface. Real-time sensor data is transmitted to Firebase, providing a synchronized platform accessible from multiple devices simultaneously. Experimental results demonstrate reliable data transmission with 99.2\% success rate, real-time control latency under 1.5 seconds, and persistent data storage for historical analysis. The system architecture offers a scalable framework for various IoT applications, from smart home automation to industrial monitoring, with a total implementation cost of \$32.50. The integration of Firebase provides robust cloud capabilities without requiring complex server infrastructure, making advanced IoT applications accessible to developers and researchers with limited resources.

AI.title_translation: 云赋能的物联网系统，用于使用 Firebase 进行实时环境监控和远程设备控制
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种基于 Firebase 的云赋能物联网系统，用于实时环境监控和远程设备控制，具有高数据传输成功率、低延迟和低成本的优点。
AI.motivation: 传统监测系统在实时数据访问、远程可控性和云集成方面存在局限性，需要更高效的解决方案。
AI.method: 利用 ESP32 微控制器连接 DHT22 温湿度传感器和 HC-SR04 超声波距离传感器，并通过 Firebase 实时数据库实现传感器数据的实时传输和 LED 指示灯的远程控制。
AI.result: 实验证明，该系统具有 99.2% 的数据传输成功率，1.5 秒以下的实时控制延迟，并能持久存储数据以供历史分析。系统成本低廉（32.50 美元），可扩展性强。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的云赋能物联网系统能够有效地利用 Firebase 实时数据库实现环境数据的实时监控和远程设备控制，具有高可靠性、低延迟、低成本和可扩展性等优点，为开发资源有限的物联网应用提供了一个切实可行的解决方案。
AI.translation: 物联网设备的激增为跨各种领域的远程监控和控制应用创造了前所未有的机会。传统的监测系统通常在实时数据可访问性、远程可控性和云集成方面存在局限性。本文提出了一种云赋能的物联网系统，该系统利用谷歌的 Firebase 实时数据库进行同步环境监测和设备控制。该系统利用 ESP32 微控制器连接 DHT22 温湿度传感器和 HC-SR04 超声波距离传感器，同时通过基于云的接口实现两个 LED 指示灯的远程控制。实时传感器数据被传输到 Firebase，提供了一个可从多个设备同时访问的同步平台。实验结果表明，数据传输可靠，成功率为 99.2%，实时控制延迟低于 1.5 秒，并能持久存储数据以供历史分析。该系统架构为从智能家居自动化到工业监测的各种物联网应用提供了可扩展的框架，总实施成本为 32.50 美元。Firebase 的集成提供了强大的云功能，而无需复杂 的服务器基础设施，使得资源有限的开发人员和研究人员能够获得先进的物联网应用。
AI.summary: 本研究设计并实现了一个云赋能的物联网系统，利用 ESP32 微控制器、DHT22 和 HC-SR04 传感器以及 Firebase 实时数据库，实现了环境数据的实时监控和 LED 指示灯的远程控制。该系统具有高数据传输可靠性、低延迟、数据持久存储和低实施成本等优点，为各种物联网应用提供了可扩展的框架。
AI.keywords: 物联网, 环境监测, Firebase, 远程控制, ESP32
AI.comments: 该研究有效地利用了 Firebase 实时数据库的优势，为物联网环境监测和远程控制提供了一个低成本、易于实现的解决方案。其高数据传输成功率和低延迟证明了其在实际应用中的可行性。然而，对于更复杂的应用场景，可能需要考虑数据安全性和隐私保护方面的问题。此外，虽然成本低廉，但扩展到大规模部署时，Firebase 的成本模型可能需要进一步评估。

title: Using psychological theory to ground guidelines for the annotation of misogynistic language
summary: Detecting misogynistic hate speech is a difficult algorithmic task. The task is made more difficult when decision criteria for what constitutes misogynistic speech are ungrounded in established literatures in psychology and philosophy, both of which have described in great detail the forms explicit and subtle misogynistic attitudes can take. In particular, the literature on algorithmic detection of misogynistic speech often rely on guidelines that are insufficiently robust or inappropriately justified -- they often fail to include various misogynistic phenomena or misrepresent their importance when they do. As a result, current misogyny detection coding schemes and datasets fail to capture the ways women experience misogyny online. This is of pressing importance: misogyny is on the rise both online and offline. Thus, the scientific community needs to have a systematic, theory informed coding scheme of misogyny detection and a corresponding dataset to train and test models of misogyny detection. To this end, we developed (1) a misogyny annotation guideline scheme informed by theoretical and empirical psychological research, (2) annotated a new dataset achieving substantial inter-rater agreement (kappa = 0.68) and (3) present a case study using Large Language Models (LLMs) to compare our coding scheme to a self-described "expert" misogyny annotation scheme in the literature. Our findings indicate that our guideline scheme surpasses the other coding scheme in the classification of misogynistic texts across 3 datasets. Additionally, we find that LLMs struggle to replicate our human annotator labels, attributable in large part to how LLMs reflect mainstream views of misogyny. We discuss implications for the use of LLMs for the purposes of misogyny detection.

AI.title_translation: 使用心理学理论为厌女症语言的注释指南提供依据
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于心理学理论的厌女症语言注释指南，并构建了一个新的数据集。实验结果表明，该指南在识别厌女症文本方面优于现有方案，并且大型语言模型在复现人类标注方面存在困难。
AI.motivation: 当前算法检测厌女症言论的标准缺乏心理学和哲学理论基础，导致现有指南不够完善，无法全面捕捉女性在线上遭受的厌女症现象，而厌女症的线上线下增长趋势使得建立系统化、理论驱动的编码方案和数据集变得至关重要。
AI.method: 1. 开发了一个受心理学理论和实证研究启发的厌女症注释指南方案；2. 构建了一个新的数据集，并实现了可观的评分者间一致性（kappa = 0.68）；3. 使用大型语言模型（LLMs）进行案例研究，将新指南方案与文献中自称“专家”的厌女症注释方案进行比较。
AI.result: 1. 新的指南方案在三个数据集上分类厌女症文本的效果优于另一个“专家”方案；2. 大型语言模型在复现人类标注者标签方面存在困难，这主要归因于大型语言模型反映了主流的厌女症观点。
AI.conclusion: 基于心理学理论的注释指南方案在识别厌女症文本方面比现有方案更有效，并且大型语言模型在理解和标注厌女症方面仍有局限性，需要进一步研究其在厌女症检测中的应用。
AI.translation: 检测厌女症仇恨言论是一项困难的算法任务。当判断何为厌女症言论的标准没有植根于心理学和哲学等既有文献时，这项任务变得更加困难，因为这些学科都详细描述了显性和隐性的厌女症态度可以采取的形式。特别是，算法检测厌女症言论的文献常常依赖于不够健全或理由不当的指南——它们常常未能包含各种厌女症现象，或者在包含时歪曲了其重要性。因此，当前的厌女症检测编码方案和数据集未能捕捉到女性在线上遭受厌女症的方式。这一点至关重要：厌女症正在线上和线下同时抬头。因此，科学界需要一个系统的、理论驱动的厌女症检测编码方案以及相应的用于训练和测试厌女症检测模型的数据集。为此，我们开发了（1）一个受理论和实证心理学研究启发的厌女症注释指南方案，（2）注释了一个新的数据集，实现了可观的评分者间一致性（kappa = 0.68），以及（3）提出了一个案例研究，使用大型语言模型（LLMs）将我们的编码方案与文献中自称“专家”的厌女症注释方案进行比较。我们的研究结果表明，在3个数据集上，我们的指南方案在分类厌女症文本方面优于其他编码方案。此外，我们发现大型语言模型在复现我们的人类标注者标签方面存在困难，这在很大程度上归因于大型语言模型反映了主流观点对厌女症的看法。我们讨论了将大型语言模型用于厌女症检测目的的意义。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种基于心理学理论的厌女症语言注释指南，旨在解决现有算法检测方法中指南不完善的问题。研究人员构建了一个新的数据集，并通过实验证明该指南在识别厌女症文本方面优于现有方案。此外，研究还发现大型语言模型在复现人类标注方面存在挑战，反映了其在理解和处理厌女症问题上的局限性。
AI.keywords: 厌女症检测, 心理学理论, 注释指南, 大型语言模型, 数据集
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入心理学理论来改进厌女症语言的检测方法，具有重要的理论和实践意义。其创新之处在于系统地将心理学理论应用于构建注释指南，并构建了相应的实证数据集。研究结果不仅证明了新方法的有效性，还揭示了当前大型语言模型在处理此类复杂社会问题时的潜在局限性，为未来研究指明了方向。然而，研究的局限性可能在于指南的普适性以及大型语言模型在不同模型和训练数据下的表现差异，这些都需要在未来的工作中进一步探讨。

title: GraphPilot: GUI Task Automation with One-Step LLM Reasoning Powered by Knowledge Graph
comments: This paper is accepted by the Journal of Intelligent Computing and Networking (JICN) for publication
summary: Mobile graphical user interface (GUI) agents are designed to automate everyday tasks on smartphones. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have significantly enhanced the capabilities of mobile GUI agents. However, most LLM-powered mobile GUI agents operate in stepwise query-act loops, which incur high latency due to repeated LLM queries. We present GraphPilot, a mobile GUI agent that leverages knowledge graphs of the target apps to complete user tasks in almost one LLM query. GraphPilot operates in two complementary phases to enable efficient and reliable LLM-powered GUI task automation. In the offline phase, it explores target apps, records and analyzes interaction history, and constructs an app-specific knowledge graph that encodes functions of pages and elements as well as transition rules for each app. In the online phase, given an app and a user task, it leverages the knowledge graph of the given app to guide the reasoning process of LLM. When the reasoning process encounters uncertainty, GraphPilot dynamically requests the HTML representation of the current interface to refine subsequent reasoning. Finally, a validator checks the generated sequence of actions against the transition rules in the knowledge graph, performing iterative corrections to ensure it is valid. The structured, informative information in the knowledge graph allows the LLM to plan the complete sequence of actions required to complete the user task. On the DroidTask benchmark, GraphPilot improves task completion rate over Mind2Web and AutoDroid, while substantially reducing latency and the number of LLM queries.
comment: This paper is accepted by the Journal of Intelligent Computing and Networking (JICN) for publication

AI.title_translation: GraphPilot：基于知识图谱的单步大语言模型推理驱动的图形用户界面任务自动化
AI.tldr: GraphPilot 是一种创新的移动 GUI 代理，它使用特定应用的知识图谱来减少大语言模型 (LLM) 的推理步骤，从而实现更快的任务自动化。它通过离线构建知识图谱和在线利用知识图谱进行推理来工作，并在需要时动态请求界面信息进行纠正，从而提高了任务完成率并降低了延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于大语言模型 (LLM) 的移动 GUI 代理通常采用分步查询-执行循环，导致高延迟。需要一种更有效的方法来自动化智能手机上的日常任务。
AI.method: GraphPilot 在离线阶段构建特定应用的知识图谱，编码页面和元素的功能以及过渡规则。在在线阶段，它利用知识图谱指导 LLM 的推理过程，并在需要时动态请求 HTML 表示以进行细化。最后，通过验证器检查动作序列并进行迭代纠正，以确保其有效性。
AI.result: 与 Mind2Web 和 AutoDroid 相比，GraphPilot 在 DroidTask 基准测试中提高了任务完成率，同时显著降低了延迟和 LLM 查询次数。
AI.conclusion: GraphPilot 通过利用知识图谱，实现了高效可靠的基于 LLM 的 GUI 任务自动化，克服了现有方法的延迟问题。
AI.translation: 移动图形用户界面 (GUI) 代理旨在自动化智能手机上的日常任务。大型语言模型 (LLM) 的最新进展显著增强了移动 GUI 代理的功能。然而，大多数基于 LLM 的移动 GUI 代理在分步查询-执行循环中运行，这会因重复的 LLM 查询而导致高延迟。我们提出了 GraphPilot，一种利用目标应用的知识图谱以几乎一次 LLM 查询完成用户任务的移动 GUI 代理。GraphPilot 在两个互补的阶段运行，以实现高效可靠的基于 LLM 的 GUI 任务自动化。在离线阶段，它会探索目标应用，记录和分析交互历史，并构建一个特定于应用的知识图谱，该图谱编码每个应用的页面和元素的功能以及过渡规则。在在线阶段，给定一个应用和用户任务，它利用给定应用的知识图谱来指导 LLM 的推理过程。当推理过程遇到不确定性时，GraphPilot 会动态请求当前界面的 HTML 表示，以完善后续推理。最后，验证器会根据知识图谱中的过渡规则检查生成的动作序列，并进行迭代纠正以确保其有效性。知识图谱中的结构化、信息丰富的数据允许 LLM 规划完成用户任务所需的完整动作序列。在 DroidTask 基准测试中，GraphPilot 提高了相对于 Mind2Web 和 AutoDroid 的任务完成率，同时显著降低了延迟和 LLM 查询次数。
AI.summary: GraphPilot 是一种用于移动 GUI 任务自动化的新方法，它利用特定应用的知识图谱来增强基于大语言模型 (LLM) 的代理。与依赖分步查询-执行循环的传统代理不同，GraphPilot 在离线阶段构建一个包含应用功能和过渡规则的知识图谱。在在线阶段，LLM 利用此知识图谱来规划和执行任务，从而通过减少 LLM 查询次数来显著降低延迟。该方法还包括一个动态界面请求机制和一个验证器，以确保动作序列的准确性和有效性。实验结果表明，GraphPilot 在 DroidTask 基准测试中优于现有方法，在提高任务完成率的同时降低了延迟。
AI.keywords: GraphPilot, GUI 自动化, 知识图谱, 大语言模型, 任务规划
AI.comments: GraphPilot 的创新之处在于其利用知识图谱来优化 LLM 的推理过程，从而实现单步或接近单步的任务规划，这对于减少延迟至关重要。通过离线构建知识图谱，它能够充分利用应用的结构信息，使得 LLM 能够更准确、更高效地生成动作序列。动态请求界面信息和验证器机制也增强了系统的鲁棒性和可靠性。然而，知识图谱的构建成本（离线阶段）以及其覆盖的广度和深度可能会影响整体性能，这可能是未来研究可以关注的方面。

title: CoT-Seg: Rethinking Segmentation with Chain-of-Thought Reasoning and Self-Correction
summary: Existing works of reasoning segmentation often fall short in complex cases, particularly when addressing complicated queries and out-of-domain images. Inspired by the chain-of-thought reasoning, where harder problems require longer thinking steps/time, this paper aims to explore a system that can think step-by-step, look up information if needed, generate results, self-evaluate its own results, and refine the results, in the same way humans approach harder questions. We introduce CoT-Seg, a training-free framework that rethinks reasoning segmentation by combining chain-of-thought reasoning with self-correction. Instead of fine-tuning, CoT-Seg leverages the inherent reasoning ability of pre-trained MLLMs (GPT-4o) to decompose queries into meta-instructions, extract fine-grained semantics from images, and identify target objects even under implicit or complex prompts. Moreover, CoT-Seg incorporates a self-correction stage: the model evaluates its own segmentation against the original query and reasoning trace, identifies mismatches, and iteratively refines the mask. This tight integration of reasoning and correction significantly improves reliability and robustness, especially in ambiguous or error-prone cases. Furthermore, our CoT-Seg framework allows easy incorporation of retrieval-augmented reasoning, enabling the system to access external knowledge when the input lacks sufficient information. To showcase CoT-Seg's ability to handle very challenging cases ,we introduce a new dataset ReasonSeg-Hard. Our results highlight that combining chain-of-thought reasoning, self-correction, offers a powerful paradigm for vision-language integration driven segmentation.

AI.title_translation: CoT-Seg：通过思维链推理和自我修正重新思考分割
AI.tldr: CoT-Seg是一个无需微调的框架，它结合了思维链推理和自我修正，用于解决复杂的推理分割问题。它利用大型多模态模型（MLLM）的推理能力，分解查询、提取图像语义、识别目标，并通过自我评估和迭代修正来提高分割的准确性和鲁棒性。该框架还支持检索增强推理，并引入了一个新的数据集ReasonSeg-Hard来评估其在挑战性案例中的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有的推理分割方法在复杂查询和非领域内图像的处理上存在不足。受思维链推理的启发，该研究旨在探索一个能够逐步思考、必要时查找信息、生成结果、自我评估并进行修正的系统，以应对更难的问题。
AI.method: CoT-Seg框架结合了思维链推理和自我修正。它利用预训练的大型多模态模型（MLLM，如GPT-4o）来分解查询为元指令，从图像中提取细粒度语义，并识别目标。该框架包含一个自我修正阶段，模型会评估其分割结果与原始查询和推理过程的匹配度，识别不匹配之处，并迭代地优化分割掩码。此外，它还支持检索增强推理，以获取外部知识。
AI.result: CoT-Seg框架在处理模糊或易出错的情况下显著提高了分割的可靠性和鲁棒性。通过结合思维链推理和自我修正，为驱动分割的视觉-语言集成提供了一个强大的范式。
AI.conclusion: 结合思维链推理和自我修正为驱动分割的视觉-语言集成提供了一个强大的范式，特别是在处理复杂和具有挑战性的推理分割任务时。
AI.translation: 现有推理分割方法在复杂情况下，尤其是在处理复杂的查询和非领域内的图像时，往往表现不佳。受思维链推理的启发，即更难的问题需要更长的思考步骤/时间，本文旨在探索一个系统，该系统可以像人类解决更难的问题一样，进行逐步思考，必要时查找信息，生成结果，自我评估其自身结果，并进行修正。我们引入了CoT-Seg，一个无需微调的框架，它通过结合思维链推理和自我修正来重新思考推理分割。CoT-Seg不进行微调，而是利用预训练的大型多模态模型（MLLM）（GPT-4o）的内在推理能力，将查询分解为元指令，从图像中提取细粒度语义，并在隐式或复杂提示下识别目标对象。此外，CoT-Seg包含一个自我修正阶段：模型根据原始查询和推理过程评估自身的分割结果，识别不匹配之处，并迭代地优化掩码。推理和修正的紧密结合显著提高了可靠性和鲁棒性，尤其是在模糊或易出错的情况下。此外，我们的CoT-Seg框架允许轻松地整合检索增强推理，使系统能够在输入信息不足时访问外部知识。为了展示CoT-Seg处理非常具有挑战性案例的能力，我们引入了一个新的数据集ReasonSeg-Hard。我们的结果强调，结合思维链推理和自我修正，为驱动分割的视觉-语言集成提供了一个强大的范式。
AI.summary: CoT-Seg是一个创新的、无需微调的框架，它通过整合思维链（CoT）推理和自我修正机制，显著提升了推理分割任务的性能，特别是在处理复杂查询和跨领域图像时。该框架利用大型多模态模型（MLLM）的内在能力，将复杂问题分解为一系列逻辑步骤，从图像中提取关键语义信息，并通过自我评估和迭代优化来精确地生成分割掩码。CoT-Seg还支持检索增强，以应对信息不足的情况，并通过引入新的挑战性数据集ReasonSeg-Hard来验证其有效性，证明了该方法在提高分割的可靠性和鲁棒性方面的潜力。
AI.keywords: 推理分割,思维链,自我修正,大型多模态模型,视觉-语言集成
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的CoT-Seg框架，通过结合思维链推理和自我修正来解决推理分割中的挑战。该方法无需微调，利用了预训练MLLM的强大能力，并在处理复杂和模糊查询方面表现出显著的改进。引入ReasonSeg-Hard数据集也是一项有价值的贡献，为评估模型在困难场景下的性能提供了基准。未来工作可以进一步探索更复杂的推理链和更精细的自我修正策略，以及在更广泛的视觉-语言任务中的应用。

title: Oops, Wait: Token-Level Signals as a Lens into LLM Reasoning
summary: The emergence of discourse-like tokens such as "wait" and "therefore" in large language models (LLMs) has offered a unique window into their reasoning processes. However, systematic analyses of how such signals vary across training strategies and model scales remain lacking. In this paper, we analyze token-level signals through token probabilities across various models. We find that specific tokens strongly correlate with reasoning correctness, varying with training strategies while remaining stable across model scales. A closer look at the "wait" token in relation to answer probability demonstrates that models fine-tuned on small-scale datasets acquire reasoning ability through such signals but exploit them only partially. This work provides a systematic lens to observe and understand the dynamics of LLM reasoning.

AI.title_translation: 哎呀，等等：令牌级信号作为 LLM 推理的透镜
AI.tldr: 研究表明，像“等待”和“因此”这样的词语可以揭示大型语言模型（LLM）的推理过程，并且这些词语的使用与推理的正确性相关。模型在不同训练策略下表现出不同的信号使用方式，但在不同模型规模下保持一致。特别是，“等待”这个词的使用方式表明，在小规模数据集上进行微调的模型能够利用这些信号进行推理，但利用程度不完全。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLM）中出现了像“等待”和“因此”这样的类似话语的代币，为理解它们的推理过程提供了一个独特的视角。然而，缺乏对这些信号如何随训练策略和模型规模变化的系统性分析。
AI.method: 通过分析各种模型的代币概率来检查代币级信号。重点关注“等待”代币与答案概率的关系。
AI.result: 研究发现，特定的代币（如“等待”）与推理的正确性高度相关。这些信号的使用方式因训练策略而异，但在不同的模型规模下保持稳定。在小规模数据集上微调的模型利用“等待”代币来获得推理能力，但利用程度并不完全。
AI.conclusion: 代币级信号，特别是像“等待”这样的词语，可以作为一种系统性的方法来观察和理解 LLM 的推理过程。这些信号的使用方式对训练策略敏感，但对模型规模不敏感，这为了解和改进 LLM 的推理能力提供了新的途径。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）中出现了类似“等待”和“因此”的代币，为我们提供了了解其推理过程的独特视角。然而，目前缺乏对这些信号如何随训练策略和模型规模变化的系统性分析。在本研究中，我们通过分析各种模型的代币概率来检查代币级信号。我们发现，特定代币与推理的正确性高度相关，并且会随着训练策略而变化，但在模型规模上保持稳定。仔细研究“等待”代币与答案概率的关系表明，在小规模数据集上进行微调的模型通过这些信号获得了推理能力，但仅部分利用了它们。这项工作为观察和理解 LLM 推理动态提供了一个系统性的视角。
AI.summary: 本研究探讨了大型语言模型（LLM）中的代币级信号，特别是像“等待”和“因此”这样的词语，如何揭示其推理过程。通过分析代币概率，研究发现这些信号与推理的正确性密切相关，并且其使用方式会受到训练策略的影响，但在不同模型规模下表现稳定。研究还发现，在小规模数据集上微调的模型能够利用这些信号进行推理，但利用程度不完全。这项工作为理解 LLM 的推理动态提供了一个系统性的分析框架。
AI.keywords: LLM推理, 代币级信号, 等待代币, 模型规模, 训练策略
AI.comments: 这项研究通过分析代币级别的信号，为理解大型语言模型（LLM）的推理过程提供了一个新颖且有价值的视角。研究的创新性在于将“等待”等看似无关紧要的代币作为研究 LLM 推理能力的切入点，并系统地分析了这些信号如何受到训练策略和模型规模的影响。研究结果具有重要意义，表明我们可以通过观察这些代币的使用来评估和潜在地改进 LLM 的推理能力。然而，研究也指出了模型的局限性，即在某些情况下，模型可能无法完全利用这些信号。未来的研究可以进一步探索如何利用这些发现来设计更有效的训练方法，以提高 LLM 的推理能力，并研究是否存在其他类似的代币可以提供更多关于 LLM 推理的信息。

title: Faster modular composition using two relation matrices
summary: Modular composition is the problem of computing the composition of two univariate polynomials modulo a third one. For a long time, the fastest algebraic algorithm for this problem was that of Brent and Kung (1978). Recently, we improved Brent and Kung's algorithm by computing and using a polynomial matrix that encodes a certain basis of algebraic relations between the polynomials. This is further improved here by making use of two polynomial matrices of smaller dimension. Under genericity assumptions on the input, this results in an algorithm using $\tilde{O}(n^{(ω+3)/4})$ arithmetic operations in the base field, where $ω$ is the exponent of matrix multiplication. With naive matrix multiplication, this is $\tilde{O}(n^{3/2})$, while with the best currently known exponent $ω$ this is $O(n^{1.343})$, improving upon the previously most efficient algorithms.

AI.title_translation: 使用两个关系矩阵实现更快的模态组合
AI.tldr: 通过使用两个较小的多项式矩阵，我们改进了模态组合算法，使其在算术运算上更快，复杂度达到了 $O(n^{1.343})$。
AI.motivation: 改进计算两个单变量多项式模第三个多项式的模态组合的最快代数算法。
AI.method: 通过计算和使用两个更小维度的多项式矩阵来改进Brent和Kung的算法。
AI.result: 在一般性假设下，算法的算术运算复杂度为 $\tilde{O}(n^{(ω+3)/4})$，使用当前已知的最佳 $ω$ 时可达 $O(n^{1.343})$。
AI.translation: 模态组合是计算两个单变量多项式模第三个多项式的问题。长期以来，该问题最快的代数算法是Brent和Kung（1978）的算法。最近，我们通过计算并使用一个对多项式间的某种代数关系基进行编码的多项式矩阵来改进了Brent和Kung的算法。本文通过利用两个更小维度的多项式矩阵进一步改进了这一点。在输入的一般性假设下，这产生了一个使用 $\tilde{O}(n^{(ω+3)/4})$ 个基域中的算术运算的算法，其中 $ω$ 是矩阵乘法的指数。使用朴素矩阵乘法，这是 $\tilde{O}(n^{3/2})$，而使用当前已知的最佳指数 $ω$，复杂度为 $O(n^{1.343})$，优于先前最高效的算法。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种改进的模态组合算法，通过利用两个更小维度的多项式矩阵，将计算复杂度从 $\tilde{O}(n^{3/2})$ 降低到 $\tilde{O}(n^{(ω+3)/4})$，从而优于先前最有效的算法。
AI.keywords: 模态组合,多项式矩阵,Brent-Kung算法,矩阵乘法,渐近复杂度
AI.comments: 该研究在现有最快算法的基础上，通过引入两个更小维度的多项式矩阵，进一步优化了模态组合的计算复杂度，尤其在采用快速矩阵乘法时，性能提升显著，是代数计算领域的重要进展。

title: Joint Uplink-Downlink Fronthaul Bit Allocation in Fronthaul-Limited Massive MU-MIMO Systems
comments: To be presented at the ICC 2026 in the wireless communication symposium
summary:
This paper optimizes the fronthaul bit allocation in massive multi-user multiple-input multiple-output (MU-MIMO) systems operating with limited-capacity fronthaul links. We consider an advanced antenna system (AAS) controlled by a centralized baseband unit (BBU). In the AAS, multiple antenna elements together with their radio units are integrated into a single unit. In this setup, a key challenge is allocating fronthaul bits between uplink channel state information (CSI) quantization and downlink precoding matrix quantization. We formulate the problem of maximizing the sum spectral efficiency (SE) for a given fronthaul capacity. We develop an SE expression for this scenario based on the hardening bound. We compute the expression in closed form for maximum ratio transmission, which reveals the relative impact of the two types of quantization distortion. We then formulate a bit split optimization problem and propose an algorithm that exactly solves it.
  Numerical results demonstrate how the relative importance of assigning bits to CSI and precoding varies depending on the signal-to-noise ratio.
comment: To be presented at the ICC 2026 in the wireless communication symposium

AI.title_translation: 前传受限大规模多用户MIMO系统中的联合上行-下行前传比特分配
AI.tldr: 针对前传受限的Massive MU-MIMO，本文提出了一种联合优化上行CSI量化和下行预编码量化比特分配的算法，以最大化系统频谱效率，并通过仿真验证了分配策略与信噪比的关系。
AI.motivation: 在具有有限容量前传链路的大规模多用户多输入多输出（MU-MIMO）系统中，如何有效地分配前传比特给上行信道状态信息（CSI）量化和下行预编码矩阵量化是一个关键挑战。
AI.method: 首先，基于硬化界（hardening bound）推导出频谱效率（SE）表达式，并为最大比传输（MRT）求得闭式解；然后，将问题建模为比特分割优化问题，并提出一个可以精确求解该问题的算法。
AI.result: 数值结果表明，分配给CSI和预编码的比特相对重要性随信噪比（SNR）的变化而变化。
AI.translation: 本文优化了工作在有限容量前传链路中的大规模多用户多输入多输出（MU-MIMO）系统的上前传比特分配。我们考虑了一个由集中式基带单元（BBU）控制的先进天线系统（AAS）。在AAS中，多个天线单元与其射频单元集成在单个单元中。在此设置中，一个关键挑战是在上行信道状态信息（CSI）量化和下行预编码矩阵量化之间分配前传比特。我们提出了在给定前传容量下最大化总频谱效率（SE）的问题。我们基于硬化界（hardening bound）为这种情况推导出了一个SE表达式，并为最大比传输（MRT）计算了闭式解，揭示了两种量化失真相对影响。然后，我们建立了一个比特分割优化问题，并提出了一个可以精确求解它的算法。数值结果表明，分配给CSI和预编码的比特的相对重要性随信噪比而变化。
AI.summary: 本文研究了在前传容量受限的大规模MU-MIMO系统中，如何联合优化上行CSI量化和下行预编码矩阵量化的比特分配，以最大化总频谱效率。研究人员推导了基于硬化界的SE表达式，并针对比特分配问题提出了一种精确求解算法。数值结果验证了比特分配策略对SNR的依赖性。
AI.keywords: Massive MU-MIMO, Fronthaul, Bit Allocation, CSI Quantization, Precoding Quantization
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于针对带有容量限制的前传链路的Massive MU-MIMO系统，联合优化了上行CSI量化和下行预编码矩阵量化的比特分配，并基于硬化界推导了SE表达式。重要性在于解决了实际部署中前传带宽受限的挑战。方法的严谨性体现在精确求解了比特分配优化问题。

title: Minimizing Completion Times of Stochastic Jobs on Parallel Machines is Hard
summary:
This paper considers the scheduling of stochastic jobs on parallel identical machines to minimize the expected total weighted completion time. While this is a classical problem with a significant body of research on approximation algorithms over the past two decades, constant-factor performance guarantees are currently known only under very restrictive assumptions on the input distributions, even when all job weights are identical. This algorithmic difficulty is striking given the lack of corresponding complexity results: to date, it is conceivable that the problem could be solved optimally in polynomial time.
  We address this gap with hardness results that demonstrate the problem's inherent intractability. For the special case of discrete two-point processing time distributions and unit weights, we prove that deciding whether there exists a scheduling policy with expected cost at most a given threshold is #P-hard. Furthermore, we show that evaluating the expected objective value of the standard (W)SEPT greedy policy is itself #P-hard. These represent the first hardness results for scheduling independent stochastic jobs and min-sum objective that do not merely rely on the intractability of the underlying deterministic counterparts.

AI.title_translation: 随机作业在并行机器上的最小完成时间是困难的
AI.tldr: 即使在所有作业权重相同的情况下，随机作业在并行机器上的最小化预期总加权完成时间问题，在仅有非常有限的输入分布假设下，也只能获得常数因子近似算法。本文填补了这一空白，证明了在离散两点处理时间分布和单位权重的情况下，该问题是#P-hard的，并且即使是标准的(W)SEPT贪心策略的预期目标值评估也是#P-hard的。
AI.motivation: 填补随机作业调度问题在复杂性研究方面的空白，证明该问题的内在难处理性。
AI.method: 对于离散两点处理时间分布和单位权重，证明了判断是否存在预期成本不超过给定阈值的调度策略是#P-hard的。此外，还证明了标准(W)SEPT贪心策略的预期目标值评估本身就是#P-hard的。
AI.result: 证明了在离散两点处理时间分布和单位权重的情况下，决策问题是#P-hard的，并且(W)SEPT贪心策略的预期目标值评估也是#P-hard的。
AI.conclusion: 随机作业在并行机器上的最小化预期总加权完成时间问题是内在难处理的，即使在离散两点分布和单位权重等特殊情况下也是如此。
AI.translation:
本论文考虑在并行相同机器上调度随机作业以最小化预期总加权完成时间。尽管这是过去二十年来拥有大量近似算法研究的经典问题，但即使在所有作业权重都相同的情况下，目前已知的常数因子性能保证也仅在对输入分布有非常严格的假设下才成立。考虑到相应复杂性结果的缺乏，这种算法上的困难是惊人的：迄今为止，人们认为该问题可以在多项式时间内最优地解决。
我们通过硬度结果来解决这一差距，这些结果证明了该问题的内在难处理性。对于离散两点处理时间分布和单位权重的特例，我们证明了判断是否存在预期成本不超过给定阈值的调度策略是#P-hard的。此外，我们还表明，标准（W）SEPT贪婪策略的预期目标值评估本身就是#P-hard的。这些是独立随机作业和最小和目标调度中第一个不完全依赖于基础确定性对应物难处理性的硬度结果。
AI.summary: 本文解决了随机作业在并行机器上最小化预期总加权完成时间的计算复杂性问题。研究表明，即使在简化的两点分布和单位权重情况下，该问题也是#P-hard的，并且常用的(W)SEPT贪心策略的评估也同样困难，这表明该问题在算法上具有挑战性。
AI.keywords: 随机作业调度,并行机器,最小化完成时间,计算复杂性,P-hard
AI.comments: 该研究首次为随机作业调度问题提供了硬度结果，填补了理论空白。然而，研究仅限于离散两点分布，未来可以扩展到更一般的分布。

title: A Syllogistic Probe: Tracing the Evolution of Logic Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: Human logic has gradually shifted from intuition-driven inference to rigorous formal systems. Motivated by recent advances in large language models (LLMs), we explore whether LLMs exhibit a similar evolution in the underlying logical framework. Using existential import as a probe, we for evaluate syllogism under traditional and modern logic. Through extensive experiments of testing SOTA LLMs on a new syllogism dataset, we have some interesting findings: (i) Model size scaling promotes the shift toward modern logic; (ii) Thinking serves as an efficient accelerator beyond parameter scaling; (iii) the Base model plays a crucial role in determining how easily and stably this shift can emerge. Beyond these core factors, we conduct additional experiments for in-depth analysis of properties of current LLMs on syllogistic reasoning.

AI.title_translation: 一个逻辑学探针：追踪大型语言模型中逻辑推理的演变
AI.tldr: 大型语言模型在模型规模、思维提示和基础模型方面表现出逻辑推理的演变，但仍需进一步研究。
AI.motivation: 探索大型语言模型（LLMs）是否像人类逻辑一样，经历了从直觉驱动的推理到形式化系统的演变。
AI.method: 使用存在性导入作为探针，在传统和现代逻辑下评估了三段论。通过在新的三段论数据集上对最先进的大型语言模型进行广泛实验来评估。
AI.result: (i) 模型规模的扩大促进了向现代逻辑的转变；(ii) 思维提示作为一种有效的加速器，其作用超越了参数扩展；(iii) 基础模型在决定这种转变出现的难易程度和稳定性方面起着至关重要的作用。
AI.conclusion: 大型语言模型在逻辑推理方面展现出类似人类的演变轨迹，模型规模、思维提示和基础模型是影响这种演变的关键因素。
AI.translation: 人类逻辑已逐渐从直觉驱动的推理转向严谨的形式系统。受近期大型语言模型（LLMs）进展的启发，我们探讨了LLMs在底层逻辑框架中是否也表现出类似的演变。我们使用存在性导入作为一种探针，在传统和现代逻辑下评估了三段论。通过在新的三段论数据集上对最先进的LLMs进行广泛实验，我们获得了一些有趣的发现：（i）模型规模的扩大促进了向现代逻辑的转变；（ii）思维提示作为一种有效的加速器，其作用超越了参数扩展；（iii）基础模型在决定这种转变出现的难易程度和稳定性方面起着至关重要的作用。除了这些核心因素外，我们还进行了额外的实验，以深入分析当前LLMs在三段论推理方面的特性。
AI.summary: 本研究利用“存在性导入”作为探针，在传统和现代逻辑框架下评估了大型语言模型（LLMs）的三段论推理能力。实验结果表明，模型规模的扩大、思维提示的引入以及基础模型的选择，都能促进LLMs逻辑推理向现代逻辑的演变。研究为理解和改进LLMs的逻辑推理能力提供了新的视角。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 逻辑推理, 三段论, 现代逻辑, 思维提示
AI.comments: 这项研究巧妙地利用“存在性导入”这一逻辑学概念作为探针，来量化和追踪大型语言模型在逻辑推理能力上的演变过程，特别是从传统逻辑向现代逻辑的转变。研究结果揭示了模型规模、思维提示（chain-of-thought）以及基础模型类型对这种转变的关键影响，为理解和提升LLMs的推理能力提供了有价值的见解。然而，研究仅限于三段论推理，其普适性有待进一步验证。未来研究可以探索更多样的逻辑推理任务和模型架构。

title: Scaling Rough Terrain Locomotion with Automatic Curriculum Reinforcement Learning
summary: Curriculum learning has demonstrated substantial effectiveness in robot learning. However, it still faces limitations when scaling to complex, wide-ranging task spaces. Such task spaces often lack a well-defined difficulty structure, making the difficulty ordering required by previous methods challenging to define. We propose a Learning Progress-based Automatic Curriculum Reinforcement Learning (LP-ACRL) framework, which estimates the agent's learning progress online and adaptively adjusts the task-sampling distribution, thereby enabling automatic curriculum generation without prior knowledge of the difficulty distribution over the task space. Policies trained with LP-ACRL enable the ANYmal D quadruped to achieve and maintain stable, high-speed locomotion at 2.5 m/s linear velocity and 3.0 rad/s angular velocity across diverse terrains, including stairs, slopes, gravel, and low-friction flat surfaces--whereas previous methods have generally been limited to high speeds on flat terrain or low speeds on complex terrain. Experimental results demonstrate that LP-ACRL exhibits strong scalability and real-world applicability, providing a robust baseline for future research on curriculum generation in complex, wide-ranging robotic learning task spaces.

AI.title_translation: 基于自动课程强化学习的粗糙地形运动学习的扩展
AI.tldr: 为了解决传统课程学习在复杂机器人任务中难以自动排序难度的问题，研究人员开发了LP-ACRL框架，该框架通过在线监测学习进度来自动创建训练课程，成功让四足机器人在楼梯、斜坡等复杂地形上实现了高稳定、高速度的运动，证明了其在复杂机器人学习中的有效性和可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 传统的课程学习方法在扩展到复杂、范围广泛的任务空间时面临局限性，因为这些任务空间通常缺乏明确定义的难度结构，使得定义所需的难度排序变得困难。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于学习进度的自动课程强化学习（LP-ACRL）框架，该框架在线估计智能体的学习进度，并自适应地调整任务采样分布，从而在没有任务空间难度分布先验知识的情况下实现自动课程生成。
AI.result: 使用LP-ACRL训练的策略使ANYmal D四足机器人在包括楼梯、斜坡、砾石和低摩擦平地在内的各种地形上，实现了2.5 m/s的线速度和3.0 rad/s的角速度的稳定、高速运动，而先前的方法通常仅限于在平地上高速或在复杂地形上低速运动。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明，LP-ACRL具有强大的可扩展性和现实世界适用性，为未来在复杂、广泛的机器人学习任务空间中进行课程生成研究提供了一个稳健的基线。
AI.translation: 课程学习在机器人学习中已经显示出巨大的有效性。然而，当扩展到复杂、范围广泛的任务空间时，它仍然面临局限性。此类任务空间通常缺乏明确定义的难度结构，使得先前方法所需的难度排序难以定义。我们提出了一种基于学习进度的自动课程强化学习（LP-ACRL）框架，它在线估计智能体的学习进度并自适应地调整任务采样分布，从而无需任务空间难度分布的先验知识即可实现自动课程生成。使用LP-ACRL训练的策略使ANYmal D四足机器人在包括楼梯、斜坡、砾石和低摩擦平地在内的各种地形上，实现了2.5 m/s的线速度和3.0 rad/s的角速度的稳定、高速运动——而先前的方法通常仅限于在平地上高速或在复杂地形上低速运动。实验结果表明，LP-ACRL具有强大的可扩展性和现实世界适用性，为未来在复杂、广泛的机器人学习任务空间中进行课程生成研究提供了一个稳健的基线。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为学习进度驱动的自动课程强化学习（LP-ACRL）的框架，用于解决传统课程学习方法在缺乏明确难度结构的复杂任务空间中难以扩展的问题。LP-ACRL通过在线估计学习进度来自动生成课程。该方法成功使ANYmal D四足机器人在多种复杂地形上实现了稳定且高速的运动（2.5 m/s线速度），展示了其在复杂机器人学习任务中的强大可扩展性和实际应用价值。
AI.keywords: 课程学习, 强化学习, 自动课程生成, 机器人运动, ANYmal D
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了基于学习进度的自动课程强化学习（LP-ACRL）框架，解决了复杂任务空间中难度结构不明确的问题，使得课程生成无需先验知识。其重要性在于成功地使ANYmal D四足机器人在复杂地形上实现了高稳定、高速度的运动，突破了现有方法的局限。局限性可能在于对“学习进度”的准确在线估计机制的细节描述不足。

title: Coronary Artery Segmentation and Vessel-Type Classification in X-Ray Angiography
summary: X-ray coronary angiography (XCA) is the clinical reference standard for assessing coronary artery disease, yet quantitative analysis is limited by the difficulty of robust vessel segmentation in routine data. Low contrast, motion, foreshortening, overlap, and catheter confounding degrade segmentation and contribute to domain shift across centers. Reliable segmentation, together with vessel-type labeling, enables vessel-specific coronary analytics and downstream measurements that depend on anatomical localization. From 670 cine sequences (407 subjects), we select a best frame near peak opacification using a low-intensity histogram criterion and apply joint super-resolution and enhancement. We benchmark classical Meijering, Frangi, and Sato vesselness filters under per-image oracle tuning, a single global mean setting, and per-image parameter prediction via Support Vector Regression (SVR). Neural baselines include U-Net, FPN, and a Swin Transformer, trained with coronary-only and merged coronary+catheter supervision. A second stage assigns vessel identity (LAD, LCX, RCA). External evaluation uses the public DCA1 cohort. SVR per-image tuning improves Dice over global means for all classical filters (e.g., Frangi: 0.759 vs. 0.741). Among deep models, FPN attains 0.914+/-0.007 Dice (coronary-only), and merged coronary+catheter labels further improve to 0.931+/-0.006. On DCA1 as a strict external test, Dice drops to 0.798 (coronary-only) and 0.814 (merged), while light in-domain fine-tuning recovers to 0.881+/-0.014 and 0.882+/-0.015. Vessel-type labeling achieves 98.5% accuracy (Dice 0.844) for RCA, 95.4% (0.786) for LAD, and 96.2% (0.794) for LCX. Learned per-image tuning strengthens classical pipelines, while high-resolution FPN models and merged-label supervision improve stability and external transfer with modest adaptation.

AI.title_translation: X射线血管造影中的冠状动脉分割和血管类型分类
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种改进X射线冠状动脉造影（XCA）中冠状动脉分割和血管类型分类的方法，通过结合超分辨率、增强技术和深度学习模型（如FPN），显著提高了分割精度和血管类型识别的准确性，并验证了其在外部数据集上的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: XCA在冠状动脉疾病评估中是临床金标准，但其定量分析受限于常规数据中血管分割的鲁棒性，低对比度、运动、缩短、重叠和导管伪影等因素会影响分割效果并导致中心间域偏移。可靠的分割和血管类型标记对于实现特定血管的冠状动脉分析至关重要。
AI.method: 研究首先从670个电影序列中选取最佳帧，应用联合超分辨率和增强技术。然后，对经典的Meijering、Frangi和Sato血管滤波方法进行了基准测试，并与支持向量回归（SVR）预测的每图像参数调优方法进行了比较。同时，还评估了U-Net、FPN和Swin Transformer等深度学习模型，分别使用了仅冠状动脉和合并冠状动脉+导管的监督训练。第二阶段对血管进行身份（LAD、LCX、RCA）分配。最后，在公开的DCA1队列上进行了外部评估，并对模型进行了小范围的域内微调。
AI.result: SVR的每图像调优方法在所有经典滤波方法上均优于全局平均设置（例如，Frangi的Dice系数从0.741提高到0.759）。在深度模型中，FPN在仅冠状动脉监督下达到了0.914±0.007的Dice系数，而合并冠状动脉+导管标签的监督则将其提高到0.931±0.006。在DCA1外部测试集上，Dice系数下降至0.798（仅冠状动脉）和0.814（合并），但经过小范围域内微调后，Dice系数分别恢复到0.881±0.014和0.882±0.015。血管类型标记方面，RCA的准确率为98.5%（Dice 0.844），LAD为95.4%（Dice 0.786），LCX为96.2%（Dice 0.794）。
AI.conclusion: 学习到的每图像调优方法可以增强经典的分割流程，而高分辨率的FPN模型和合并标签的监督学习方法则通过适度的适应性调整，提高了分割的稳定性和在外部数据集上的迁移能力。
AI.translation: X射线冠状动脉造影（XCA）是评估冠状动脉疾病的临床参考标准，然而，由于常规数据中血管分割的鲁棒性困难，定量分析受到限制。低对比度、运动、缩短、重叠和导管的干扰会降低分割效果，并导致中心间的域偏移。可靠的分割以及血管类型标记，能够实现特定血管的冠状动脉分析以及依赖于解剖定位的下游测量。我们从670个电影序列（407名受试者）中，使用低强度直方图标准选择近达峰值显影的最佳帧，并应用联合超分辨率和增强。我们对经典的Meijering、Frangi和Sato血管滤波方法进行了基准测试，分别在每图像神谕调优、单一全局平均设置以及通过支持向量回归（SVR）进行每图像参数预测下进行评估。神经网络基线包括U-Net、FPN和Swin Transformer，分别使用仅冠状动脉和合并冠状动脉+导管的监督进行训练。第二阶段分配血管身份（LAD、LCX、RCA）。外部评估使用了公开的DCA1队列。SVR的每图像调优比全局平均值提高了所有经典滤波器的Dice系数（例如，Frangi：0.759 vs. 0.741）。在深度模型中，FPN达到了0.914±0.007的Dice系数（仅冠状动脉），合并冠状动脉+导管标签进一步提高到0.931±0.006。在DCA1作为严格的外部测试中，Dice系数下降到0.798（仅冠状动脉）和0.814（合并），而轻度的域内微调可恢复到0.881±0.014和0.882±0.015。血管类型标记在RCA上达到98.5%的准确率（Dice 0.844），在LAD上达到95.4%（0.786），在LCX上达到96.2%（0.794）。学习到的每图像调优增强了经典的流程，而高分辨率FPN模型和合并标签监督通过适度的适应性改进了稳定性和外部迁移能力。
AI.summary: 本研究旨在解决X射线冠状动脉造影（XCA）中冠状动脉分割和血管类型分类的挑战。研究人员提出了一种结合图像增强、超分辨率处理以及多种分割方法（包括经典滤波和深度学习模型如FPN）的综合框架。实验结果表明，通过使用支持向量回归进行每图像参数调优，经典方法得到了改进；而FPN模型在结合冠状动脉和导管信息进行监督训练时，达到了最高的分割精度。研究还评估了模型在外部数据集上的泛化能力，并发现通过少量微调可以显著恢复性能。最后，研究实现了高精度的血管类型（LAD、LCX、RCA）分类。
AI.keywords: 冠状动脉分割, X射线血管造影, 深度学习, FPN, 血管类型分类
AI.comments: 该研究在XCA图像分析领域取得了显著进展，特别是在提高血管分割的鲁棒性和准确性方面。利用深度学习模型（如FPN）并结合多源信息（冠状动脉+导管）进行监督训练，以及通过SVR实现自适应参数调优，都是有价值的贡献。研究强调了模型在外部数据集上的泛化能力和适应性微调的重要性，这对于临床应用至关重要。然而，报告的Dice系数在外部测试集上仍有较大下降，表明在处理真实世界的多样化数据时，仍有进一步改进的空间。

title: Active Hypothesis Testing for Correlated Combinatorial Anomaly Detection
summary: We study the problem of identifying an anomalous subset of streams under correlated noise, motivated by monitoring and security in cyber-physical systems. This problem can be viewed as a form of combinatorial pure exploration, where each stream plays the role of an arm and measurements must be allocated sequentially under uncertainty. Existing combinatorial bandit and hypothesis testing methods typically assume independent observations and fail to exploit correlation for efficient measurement design. We propose ECC-AHT, an adaptive algorithm that selects continuous, constrained measurements to maximize Chernoff information between competing hypotheses, enabling active noise cancellation through differential sensing. ECC-AHT achieves optimal sample complexity guarantees and significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both synthetic and real-world correlated environments. The code is available on https://github.com/VincentdeCristo/ECC-AHT

AI.title_translation: 用于相关组合异常检测的主动假设检验
AI.tldr: 针对网络物理系统中的相关噪声异常检测问题，我们提出了 ECC-AHT 算法，它通过最大化 Chernoff 信息来主动抵消噪声，在保证最优样本效率的同时，性能优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 研究在存在相关噪声的情况下识别异常数据流子集的问题，这源于网络物理系统中的监控和安全需求。现有的方法在处理相关观测时效率低下。
AI.method: 提出 ECC-AHT，一种自适应算法，通过选择连续、受限的测量来最大化竞争假设之间的 Chernoff 信息，从而实现通过差分传感进行主动噪声抵消。
AI.result: ECC-AHT 算法实现了最优的样本复杂度保证，并在合成和真实世界的相关环境中显著优于现有技术。
AI.conclusion: ECC-AHT 算法在合成和真实世界相关环境中取得了最佳的样本复杂度保证，并显著优于最先进的基线方法。
AI.translation: 我们研究了在存在相关噪声的情况下识别异常数据流子集的问题，其动机是网络物理系统中的监控和安全。这个问题可以看作是一种组合纯探索形式，其中每个数据流扮演一个“臂”的角色，并且测量必须在不确定性下顺序分配。现有的组合老虎机和假设检验方法通常假设观测是独立的，并且未能利用相关性来进行高效的测量设计。我们提出了 ECC-AHT，一种自适应算法，它选择连续的、受限的测量来最大化竞争假设之间的 Chernoff 信息，从而通过差分传感实现主动噪声抵消。ECC-AHT 在合成和真实世界的相关环境中实现了最优的样本复杂度保证，并显著优于最先进的基线方法。代码可在 https://github.com/VincentdeCristo/ECC-AHT 上获取。
AI.summary: 本文研究了在存在相关噪声的情况下识别异常数据流子集的问题，并提出了一种名为 ECC-AHT 的自适应算法。该算法通过最大化竞争假设间的 Chernoff 信息来指导连续测量选择，从而实现主动噪声抵消，并在相关环境中实现了最优的样本复杂度。
AI.keywords: 组合异常检测, 相关噪声, 主动假设检验, Chernoff信息, 组合纯探索
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一种利用相关性进行主动噪声抵消的自适应算法（ECC-AHT），解决了现有方法在相关噪声下效率低下的问题。其重要性在于提升了网络物理系统中异常检测的效率和准确性。方法依赖于最大化竞争假设间的Chernoff信息来实现高效测量设计。

title: The 17% Gap: Quantifying Epistemic Decay in AI-Assisted Survey Papers
summary: The adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) in scientific writing promises efficiency but risks introducing informational entropy. While "hallucinated papers" are a known artifact, the systematic degradation of valid citation chains remains unquantified. We conducted a forensic audit of 50 recent survey papers in Artificial Intelligence (N=5,514 citations) published between September 2024 and January 2026. We utilized a hybrid verification pipeline combining DOI resolution, Crossref metadata analysis, Semantic Scholar queries, and fuzzy text matching to distinguish between formatting errors ("Sloppiness") and verifiable non-existence ("Phantoms). We detect a persistent 17.0% Phantom Rate -- citations that cannot be resolved to any digital object despite aggressive forensic recovery. Diagnostic categorization reveals three distinct failure modes: pure hallucinations (5.1%), hallucinated identifiers with valid titles (16.4%), and parsing-induced matching failures (78.5%). Longitudinal analysis reveals a flat trend (+0.07 pp/month), suggesting that high-entropy citation practices have stabilized as an endemic feature of the field. The scientific citation graph in AI survey literature exhibits "link rot" at scale. This suggests a mechanism where AI tools act as "lazy research assistants," retrieving correct titles but hallucinating metadata, thereby severing the digital chain of custody required for reproducible science.

AI.title_translation: AI辅助调查论文中知识衰减的量化：“17%的差距”
AI.tldr: AI辅助撰写的AI调查论文中，有17%的引用是无法找到的“幻影”引用，表明AI正在大规模地破坏科学引文链的数字可追溯性，这种问题已经固化。
AI.motivation: LLM在科学写作中的应用带来了效率，但也带来了信息熵增的风险。系统性降级有效引文链的现象尚未被量化。
AI.method: 对2024年9月至2026年1月间发表的50篇AI领域调查论文（共5,514个引用）进行了法证审计。使用结合DOI解析、Crossref元数据分析、Semantic Scholar查询和模糊文本匹配的混合验证流程，区分了格式错误（“草率”）和可验证的不存在（“幻影”）。
AI.result: 检测到持续的17.0%的“幻影率”——即无法解析到任何数字对象的引用。诊断分类显示了三种不同的失败模式：纯粹的幻觉（5.1%）、带有有效标题的幻觉标识符（16.4%）和由解析引起的匹配失败（78.5%）。纵向分析显示趋势平坦（每月+0.07个百分点）。
AI.conclusion: AI工具在科学引文生成中充当“懒惰的研究助理”，检索到正确的标题但虚构了元数据，导致AI调查文献中的科学引文图谱以规模化的方式表现出“链接腐烂”（link rot），这种高熵的引文实践已经稳定成为该领域的地方性特征。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在科学写作中的应用带来了效率，但也带来了信息熵增的风险。虽然“幻觉论文”是一个已知的产物，但有效引文链的系统性降级尚未被量化。我们对2024年9月至2026年1月间在人工智能领域（N=5,514个引用）发表的50篇最新调查论文进行了法证审计。我们利用结合DOI解析、Crossref元数据分析、Semantic Scholar查询和模糊文本匹配的混合验证流程，以区分格式错误（“草率”）和可验证的不存在（“幻影”）。我们检测到持续的17.0%的“幻影率”——即尽管积极进行法证恢复，也无法解析到任何数字对象的引用。诊断分类揭示了三种不同的失败模式：纯粹的幻觉（5.1%）、带有有效标题的幻觉标识符（16.4%）和由解析引起的匹配失败（78.5%）。纵向分析显示趋势平坦（每月+0.07个百分点），表明高熵的引文实践已经稳定成为该领域的固有特征。AI调查文献中的科学引文图谱以规模化的方式表现出“链接腐烂”。这表明了一种机制，其中AI工具充当“懒惰的研究助理”，检索到正确的标题但虚构了元数据，从而切断了可复现科学所需的数字保管链。
AI.summary: 本研究量化了AI辅助科学写作对引文链的系统性降级。通过对50篇AI调查论文的法证审计，发现存在17.0%的“幻影率”，即无法验证的引用。分析表明，AI工具正在以规模化的方式破坏AI领域科学引文图谱的可再现性。
AI.keywords: 知识衰减, 幻影率, LLM, 调查论文, 引文验证
AI.comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于首次量化了AI辅助写作对科学引文链的系统性降级（“知识衰减”），将其细分为“幻影”和“草率”两类，并发现了一个持续的17%的“幻影率”。其重要性在于揭示了LLM在科学写作中引入的、难以察觉的、破坏科学可复现性的结构性问题。局限性在于仅针对AI领域的调查论文进行了审计。

title: An algorithmic approach to direct spline products: procedures and computational aspects
summary: We introduce an efficient algorithmic procedure for implementing the direct formula that represents the product of splines in the B-spline basis. We first demonstrate the relevance of this direct approach through numerical evidences showing that implicit methods, such as collocation, may fail in some instances due to severe ill-conditioning of the associated system matrices, whereas the direct formula remains robust. We then recast the direct formula into an algorithmic framework based on the Oslo Algorithm and subsequently enhance it, through a factorization of the terms to be computed, to dramatically improve computational efficiency. Extensive numerical experiments illustrate the substantial reduction in computational cost achieved by the proposed method. Implementation aspects are also discussed to ensure numerical stability and applicability.

title: Co-Designing Digital Humans for Online Learning: A Framework for Human-AI Pedagogical Integration
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) and large language models (LLMs) are reshaping education, with virtual avatars emerging as digital teachers capable of enhancing engagement, sustaining attention, and addressing instructor shortages. Aligned with the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) for equitable quality education, these technologies hold promise yet lack clear guidelines for effective design and implementation in online learning. To fill this gap, we introduce a framework specifying when, what, and how digital teachers should be integrated. Our study combines (1) a design space analysis of 87 works across AI, educational technology, design, and HCI, (2) a survey of 132 learners' practices and preferences, and (3) three co-design workshops with 18 experts from pedagogy, design, and AI. It provides actionable guidance for educators, designers, and HCI researchers, advancing opportunities to build more engaging, equitable, and effective online learning environments powered by digital teachers.

AI.title_translation: 共同设计数字人类以用于在线学习：一个人机教学整合的框架
AI.tldr: 研究通过综合分析、调查和共创工作坊，提出了一个框架，以指导如何在在线学习中有效整合人工智能驱动的数字教师，以提升教育质量和公平性。
AI.motivation: 人工智能和大型语言模型正在重塑教育，虚拟化身作为数字教师出现，有望增强参与度、维持注意力并解决师资短缺问题，以实现公平的优质教育（SDGs）。然而，目前缺乏有效的在线学习中数字教师设计和实施的明确指南。
AI.method: 结合了对87项跨领域（AI、教育技术、设计和HCI）工作的设计空间分析、对132名学习者实践和偏好的调查，以及与18位来自教学法、设计和人工智能的专家的三次共同设计工作坊。
AI.result: 提出了一个框架，明确规定了何时、何种以及如何整合数字教师。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为教育工作者、设计师和人机交互研究人员提供了可操作的指导，以构建更具吸引力、公平和有效的由数字教师驱动的在线学习环境。
AI.translation: 人工智能（AI）和大型语言模型（LLMs）正在重塑教育，虚拟化身作为数字教师出现，能够增强参与度、维持注意力和解决师资短缺问题。这与可持续发展目标（SDGs）中关于公平优质教育的目标相一致，这些技术前景广阔，但在在线学习中的有效设计和实施方面缺乏明确的指导方针。为填补这一空白，我们提出了一个框架，明确规定了数字教师应何时、何种以及如何整合。我们的研究结合了（1）对横跨人工智能、教育技术、设计和人机交互的87项工作的设计空间分析，（2）对132名学习者实践和偏好的调查，以及（3）与18位来自教学法、设计和人工智能专家的三次共同设计工作坊。它为教育工作者、设计师和人机交互研究人员提供了可操作的指导，以推进构建更具吸引力、公平和有效的由数字教师驱动的在线学习环境的机会。
AI.summary: 为解决在线学习中数字教师设计和实施缺乏明确指南的问题，本研究提出了一个整合框架，该框架通过设计空间分析、学习者调查和专家共创工作坊相结合的方法得出，旨在指导构建更具吸引力、公平和有效的数字教师驱动的学习环境。
AI.keywords: 数字人类, 在线学习, 人工智能, 教学整合, 共同设计
AI.comments: 该研究的创新点在于提出了一个明确的框架，指导数字教师的集成，并结合了设计空间分析、学习者调查和专家共创工作坊，具有很强的实践指导意义。其局限性在于侧重于在线学习场景，可能未完全覆盖所有教育环境。

title: Towards a Declarative Agentic Layer for Intelligent Agents in MCP-Based Server Ecosystems
summary: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have enabled the development of increasingly complex agentic and multi-agent systems capable of planning, tool use and task decomposition. However, empirical evidence shows that many of these systems suffer from fundamental reliability issues, including hallucinated actions, unexecutable plans and brittle coordination. Crucially, these failures do not stem from limitations of the underlying models themselves, but from the absence of explicit architectural structure linking goals, capabilities and execution. This paper presents a declarative, model-independent architectural layer for grounded agentic workflows that addresses this gap. The proposed layer, referred to as DALIA (Declarative Agentic Layer for Intelligent Agents), formalises executable capabilities, exposes tasks through a declarative discovery protocol, maintains a federated directory of agents and their execution resources, and constructs deterministic task graphs grounded exclusively in declared operations. By enforcing a clear separation between discovery, planning and execution, the architecture constrains agent behaviour to a verifiable operational space, reducing reliance on speculative reasoning and free-form coordination. We present the architecture and design principles of the proposed layer and illustrate its operation through a representative task-oriented scenario, demonstrating how declarative grounding enables reproducible and verifiable agentic workflows across heterogeneous environments.

title: UniGRec: Unified Generative Recommendation with Soft Identifiers for End-to-End Optimization
summary:
Generative recommendation has recently emerged as a transformative paradigm that directly generates target items, surpassing traditional cascaded approaches. It typically involves two components: a tokenizer that learns item identifiers and a recommender trained on them. Existing methods often decouple tokenization from recommendation or rely on asynchronous alternating optimization, limiting full end-to-end alignment. To address this, we unify the tokenizer and recommender under the ultimate recommendation objective via differentiable soft item identifiers, enabling joint end-to-end training. However, this introduces three challenges: training-inference discrepancy due to soft-to-hard mismatch, item identifier collapse from codeword usage imbalance, and collaborative signal deficiency due to an overemphasis on fine-grained token-level semantics.
  To tackle these challenges, we propose UniGRec, a unified generative recommendation framework that addresses them from three perspectives. UniGRec employs Annealed Inference Alignment during tokenization to smoothly bridge soft training and hard inference, a Codeword Uniformity Regularization to prevent identifier collapse and encourage codebook diversity, and a Dual Collaborative Distillation mechanism that distills collaborative priors from a lightweight teacher model to jointly guide both the tokenizer and the recommender. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that UniGRec consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baseline methods. Our codes are available at https://github.com/Jialei-03/UniGRec.

title: PILOT: A Perceptive Integrated Low-level Controller for Loco-manipulation over Unstructured Scenes
summary: Humanoid robots hold great potential for diverse interactions and daily service tasks within human-centered environments, necessitating controllers that seamlessly integrate precise locomotion with dexterous manipulation. However, most existing whole-body controllers lack exteroceptive awareness of the surrounding environment, rendering them insufficient for stable task execution in complex, unstructured scenarios.To address this challenge, we propose PILOT, a unified single-stage reinforcement learning (RL) framework tailored for perceptive loco-manipulation, which synergizes perceptive locomotion and expansive whole-body control within a single policy. To enhance terrain awareness and ensure precise foot placement, we design a cross-modal context encoder that fuses prediction-based proprioceptive features with attention-based perceptive representations. Furthermore, we introduce a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) policy architecture to coordinate diverse motor skills, facilitating better specialization across distinct motion patterns. Extensive experiments in both simulation and on the physical Unitree G1 humanoid robot validate the efficacy of our framework. PILOT demonstrates superior stability, command tracking precision, and terrain traversability compared to existing baselines. These results highlight its potential to serve as a robust, foundational low-level controller for loco-manipulation in unstructured scenes.

title: Data-driven Clustering and Merging of Adapters for On-device Large Language Models
summary: On-device large language models commonly employ task-specific adapters (e.g., LoRAs) to deliver strong performance on downstream tasks. While storing all available adapters is impractical due to memory constraints, mobile devices typically have sufficient capacity to store a limited number of these parameters. This raises a critical challenge: how to select representative adapters that generalize well across multiple tasks - a problem that remains unexplored in existing literature. We propose a novel method D2C for adapter clustering that leverages minimal task-specific examples (e.g., 10 per task) and employs an iterative optimization process to refine cluster assignments. The adapters within each cluster are merged, creating multi-task adapters deployable on resource-constrained devices. Experimental results demonstrate that our method effectively boosts performance for considered storage budgets.

title: A new approach for combined model class selection and parameters learning for auto-regressive neural models
summary: This work introduces a novel approach for the joint selection of model structure and parameter learning for nonlinear dynamical systems identification. Focusing on a specific Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) family, i.e., Nonlinear Auto-Regressive with eXogenous inputs Echo State Networks (NARXESNs), the method allows to simultaneously select the optimal model class and learn model parameters from data through a new set-membership (SM) based procedure. The results show the effectiveness of the approach in identifying parsimonious yet accurate models suitable for control applications. Moreover, the proposed framework enables a robust training strategy that explicitly accounts for bounded measurement noise and enhances model robustness by allowing data-consistent evaluation of simulation performance during parameter learning, a process generally NP-hard for models with autoregressive components.

title: Clustering-driven Memory Compression for On-device Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) often rely on user-specific memories distilled from past interactions to enable personalized generation. A common practice is to concatenate these memories with the input prompt, but this approach quickly exhausts the limited context available in on-device LLMs. Compressing memories by averaging can mitigate context growth, yet it frequently harms performance due to semantic conflicts across heterogeneous memories. In this work, we introduce a clustering-based memory compression strategy that balances context efficiency and personalization quality. Our method groups memories by similarity and merges them within clusters prior to concatenation, thereby preserving coherence while reducing redundancy. Experiments demonstrate that our approach substantially lowers the number of memory tokens while outperforming baseline strategies such as naive averaging or direct concatenation. Furthermore, for a fixed context budget, clustering-driven merging yields more compact memory representations and consistently enhances generation quality.

title: Building a Bridge between the Two Schools: Realizing a Practical Path to Include Literacy-based Skills within the STEM Curricula
summary: Developing students as well-rounded professionals is increasingly important for our modern society. Although there is a great consensus that technical and professional ("soft") skills should be developed and intertwined in the core of computer science subjects, there are still few examples of alike teaching methodologies at technical schools. This contribution investigates the integration of technical and professional skills while teaching specialized curricula in computer science. We propose a broadly applicable, step-by-step methodology that connects core technical concepts (e.g., information entropy, network security) with fine arts practices such as music, video production, gaming, and performing arts (e.g., Oxford-style debates). The methodology was applied in several computer science courses at technical universities, where quantitative and qualitative assessments, including student questionnaires and exam scores, showed improved learning outcomes and increased student engagement compared to traditional methods. The results indicate that this art-based integration can effectively bridge the historical divide between the two schools of thought, offering a practical direction for educators. Within this context, we also identify open issues that will guide future research on topics such as instructor engagement, female motivation in technical subjects, and scalability of these approaches.

title: DREAM: Dual-Standard Semantic Homogeneity with Dynamic Optimization for Graph Learning with Label Noise
summary: Graph neural networks (GNNs) have been widely used in various graph machine learning scenarios. Existing literature primarily assumes well-annotated training graphs, while the reliability of labels is not guaranteed in real-world scenarios. Recently, efforts have been made to address the problem of graph learning with label noise. However, existing methods often (i) struggle to distinguish between reliable and unreliable nodes, and (ii) overlook the relational information embedded in the graph topology. To tackle this problem, this paper proposes a novel method, Dual-Standard Semantic Homogeneity with Dynamic Optimization (DREAM), for reliable, relation-informed optimization on graphs with label noise. Specifically, we design a relation-informed dynamic optimization framework that iteratively reevaluates the reliability of each labeled node in the graph during the optimization process according to the relation of the target node and other nodes. To measure this relation comprehensively, we propose a dual-standard selection strategy that selects a set of anchor nodes based on both node proximity and graph topology. Subsequently, we compute the semantic homogeneity between the target node and the anchor nodes, which serves as guidance for optimization. We also provide a rigorous theoretical analysis to justify the design of DREAM. Extensive experiments are performed on six graph datasets across various domains under three types of graph label noise against competing baselines, and the results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed DREAM.

title: Data-driven Test Generation for Fuzzing AI Compiler
comments: This paper has been accepted by ICSE 2026 Doctoral Symposium track
summary: Artificial Intelligence (AI) compilers are critical for efficiently deploying AI models across diverse hardware platforms. However, they remain prone to bugs that can compromise both compiler reliability and model correctness. Thus, ensuring the quality of AI compilers is crucial. In this work, we present a unified data-driven testing framework that systematically addresses stage-specific challenges in AI compilers. Specifically, OPERA migrates tests for AI libraries to test various operator conversion logic in the model loading stage. OATest synthesizes diverse optimization-aware computational graphs for testing high-level optimizations. HARMONY generates and mutates diverse low-level IR seeds to generate hardware-optimization-aware tests for testing low-level optimizations. Together, these techniques provide a comprehensive, stage-aware framework that enhances testing coverage and effectiveness, detecting 266 previously unknown bugs in four widely used AI compilers.

title: Numerical Study of Dissipative Weak Solutions for the Euler Equations of Gas Dynamics
summary: We study dissipative weak (DW) solutions of the Euler equations of gas dynamics using the first-, second-, third-, fifth-, seventh-, and ninth-order local characteristic decomposition-based central-upwind (LCDCU), low-dissipation central-upwind (LDCU), and viscous finite volume (VFV) methods, whose higher-order extensions are obtained via the framework of the alternative weighted essentially non-oscillatory (A-WENO) schemes. These methods are applied to several benchmark problems, including several two-dimensional Riemann problems and a Kelvin-Helmholtz instability test. The numerical results demonstrate that for methods converging only weakly in space and time, the limiting solutions are generalized DW solutions, approximated in the sense of ${\cal K}$-convergence and dependent on the numerical scheme. For all of the studied methods, we compute the associated Young measures and compare the DW solutions using entropy production and energy defect criteria.

title: Embodiment-Induced Coordination Regimes in Tabular Multi-Agent Q-Learning
summary: Centralized value learning is often assumed to improve coordination and stability in multi-agent reinforcement learning, yet this assumption is rarely tested under controlled conditions. We directly evaluate it in a fully tabular predator-prey gridworld by comparing independent and centralized Q-learning under explicit embodiment constraints on agent speed and stamina. Across multiple kinematic regimes and asymmetric agent roles, centralized learning fails to provide a consistent advantage and is frequently outperformed by fully independent learning, even under full observability and exact value estimation. Moreover, asymmetric centralized-independent configurations induce persistent coordination breakdowns rather than transient learning instability. By eliminating confounding effects from function approximation and representation learning, our tabular analysis isolates coordination structure as the primary driver of these effects. The results show that increased coordination can become a liability under embodiment constraints, and that the effectiveness of centralized learning is fundamentally regime and role dependent rather than universal.

title: When Seconds Count: Designing Real-Time VR Interventions for Stress Inoculation Training in Novice Physicians
comments: In Proceedings of the 2026 CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems (CHI'26), April 13-17, 2026, Barcelona, Spain
summary: Surgical emergencies often trigger acute cognitive overload in novice physicians, impairing their decision-making under pressure. Although Virtual Reality-based Stress Inoculation Training (VR-SIT) shows promise, current systems fall short in delivering real-time, effective support during moments of peak stress. To bridge this gap, we first conducted a formative study (N=12) to uncover the core needs of novice physicians for immediate assistance under acute stress and identified three key intervention strategies: self-regulation aids, procedure guidance, and emotional/sensory support. Building on these insights, we designed and implemented a novel VR-SIT system that incorporates a just-in-time adaptive intervention framework, dynamically tailoring support to learners' cognitive and emotional states. We then validated these strategies in a user study (N=26). Our findings provide empirical evidence and design implications for next-generation VR medical training systems, supporting physicians in sustaining cognitive clarity and accurate decision-making in critical situations.

title: Robust Output Regulation of Uncertain Linear Time-Varying Systems
summary: Robust output regulation for linear time-varying systems has remained an open problem for decades. To address this, we propose intrinsic system immersion by reformulating the regulator equation in a more insightful form, indicating that finding an internal model is equivalent to reproducing the output trajectory of a forced system by constructing an unforced system. This perspective reveals the influence of parametric uncertainties, demonstrating that an infinite-dimensional controller is generally unavoidable for robustness against plant uncertainty. Consequently, a general robust design is proposed without explicitly solving the regulator equation. It ensures robustness against uncertainties in the exosystem interaction, and achieves approximate output regulation when an infinite-dimensional controller is necessary for regulation. Additionally, we study the regulator equation in a coordinate-free framework, extend the time-varying non-resonance condition, and provide a method to minimize the dimension of an internal model. Overall, these results provide a general systematic framework for constructing robust internal model-based controllers, and simplify the control implementation process.

title: Harnessing Reasoning Trajectories for Hallucination Detection via Answer-agreement Representation Shaping
summary: Large reasoning models (LRMs) often generate long, seemingly coherent reasoning traces yet still produce incorrect answers, making hallucination detection challenging. Although trajectories contain useful signals, directly using trace text or vanilla hidden states for detection is brittle: traces vary in form and detectors can overfit to superficial patterns rather than answer validity. We introduce Answer-agreement Representation Shaping (ARS), which learns detection-friendly trace-conditioned representations by explicitly encoding answer stability. ARS generates counterfactual answers through small latent interventions, specifically, perturbing the trace-boundary embedding, and labels each perturbation by whether the resulting answer agrees with the original. It then learns representations that bring answer-agreeing states together and separate answer-disagreeing ones, exposing latent instability indicative of hallucination risk. The shaped embeddings are plug-and-play with existing embedding-based detectors and require no human annotations during training. Experiments demonstrate that ARS consistently improves detection and achieves substantial gains over strong baselines.

title: ReflexSplit: Single Image Reflection Separation via Layer Fusion-Separation
summary: Single Image Reflection Separation (SIRS) disentangles mixed images into transmission and reflection layers. Existing methods suffer from transmission-reflection confusion under nonlinear mixing, particularly in deep decoder layers, due to implicit fusion mechanisms and inadequate multi-scale coordination. We propose ReflexSplit, a dual-stream framework with three key innovations. (1) Cross-scale Gated Fusion (CrGF) adaptively aggregates semantic priors, texture details, and decoder context across hierarchical depths, stabilizing gradient flow and maintaining feature consistency. (2) Layer Fusion-Separation Blocks (LFSB) alternate between fusion for shared structure extraction and differential separation for layer-specific disentanglement. Inspired by Differential Transformer, we extend attention cancellation to dual-stream separation via cross-stream subtraction. (3) Curriculum training progressively strengthens differential separation through depth-dependent initialization and epoch-wise warmup. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art performance with superior perceptual quality and robust generalization. Our code is available at https://github.com/wuw2135/ReflexSplit.

title: Identifying and Correcting Label Noise for Robust GNNs via Influence Contradiction
summary: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have shown remarkable capabilities in learning from graph-structured data with various applications such as social analysis and bioinformatics. However, the presence of label noise in real scenarios poses a significant challenge in learning robust GNNs, and their effectiveness can be severely impacted when dealing with noisy labels on graphs, often stemming from annotation errors or inconsistencies. To address this, in this paper we propose a novel approach called ICGNN that harnesses the structure information of the graph to effectively alleviate the challenges posed by noisy labels. Specifically, we first design a novel noise indicator that measures the influence contradiction score (ICS) based on the graph diffusion matrix to quantify the credibility of nodes with clean labels, such that nodes with higher ICS values are more likely to be detected as having noisy labels. Then we leverage the Gaussian mixture model to precisely detect whether the label of a node is noisy or not. Additionally, we develop a soft strategy to combine the predictions from neighboring nodes on the graph to correct the detected noisy labels. At last, pseudo-labeling for abundant unlabeled nodes is incorporated to provide auxiliary supervision signals and guide the model optimization. Experiments on benchmark datasets show the superiority of our proposed approach.

title: PhaSR: Generalized Image Shadow Removal with Physically Aligned Priors
summary: Shadow removal under diverse lighting conditions requires disentangling illumination from intrinsic reflectance, a challenge compounded when physical priors are not properly aligned. We propose PhaSR (Physically Aligned Shadow Removal), addressing this through dual-level prior alignment to enable robust performance from single-light shadows to multi-source ambient lighting. First, Physically Aligned Normalization (PAN) performs closed-form illumination correction via Gray-world normalization, log-domain Retinex decomposition, and dynamic range recombination, suppressing chromatic bias. Second, Geometric-Semantic Rectification Attention (GSRA) extends differential attention to cross-modal alignment, harmonizing depth-derived geometry with DINO-v2 semantic embeddings to resolve modal conflicts under varying illumination. Experiments show competitive performance in shadow removal with lower complexity and generalization to ambient lighting where traditional methods fail under multi-source illumination. Our source code is available at https://github.com/ming053l/PhaSR.

title: PatchIsland: Orchestration of LLM Agents for Continuous Vulnerability Repair
summary:
Continuous fuzzing platforms such as OSS-Fuzz uncover large numbers of vulnerabilities, yet the subsequent repair process remains largely manual. Unfortunately, existing Automated Vulnerability Repair (AVR) techniques -- including recent LLM-based systems -- are not directly applicable to continuous fuzzing. This is because these systems are designed and evaluated on a static, single-run benchmark setting, making them ill-suited for the diverse, noisy, and failure-prone environments in continuous fuzzing.
  To address these issues, we introduce PatchIsland, a system for Continuous Vulnerability Repair (CVR) that tightly integrates with continuous fuzzing pipelines. PatchIsland employs an ensemble of diverse LLM agents. By leveraging multiple LLM agents, PatchIsland can cover a wider range of settings (e.g., different projects, bug types, and programming languages) and also improve operational robustness. In addition, PatchIsland utilizes a two-phase patch-based deduplication to mitigate duplicate crashes and patches, which can be problematic in continuous fuzzing.
  In our internal evaluation, PatchIsland repaired 84 of 92 vulnerabilities, demonstrating strong repair capability. In the official AIxCC competition, the system operated with no human intervention in a fully autonomous environment and successfully patched 31 out of 43 vulnerabilities, achieving a repair rate of 72.1\%.

title: Adversarial Alignment and Disentanglement for Cross-Domain CTR Prediction with Domain-Encompassing Features
summary: Cross-domain recommendation (CDR) has been increasingly explored to address data sparsity and cold-start issues. However, recent approaches typically disentangle domain-invariant features shared between source and target domains, as well as domain-specific features for each domain. However, they often rely solely on domain-invariant features combined with target domain-specific features, which can lead to suboptimal performance. To overcome the limitations, this paper presents the Adversarial Alignment and Disentanglement Cross-Domain Recommendation ($A^2DCDR$ ) model, an innovative approach designed to capture a comprehensive range of cross-domain information, including both domain-invariant and valuable non-aligned features. The $A^2DCDR$ model enhances cross-domain recommendation through three key components: refining MMD with adversarial training for better generalization, employing a feature disentangler and reconstruction mechanism for intra-domain disentanglement, and introducing a novel fused representation combining domain-invariant, non-aligned features with original contextual data. Experiments on real-world datasets and online A/B testing show that $A^2DCDR$ outperforms existing methods, confirming its effectiveness and practical applicability. The code is provided at https://github.com/youzi0925/A-2DCDR/tree/main.

title: LeanTutor: Towards a Verified AI Mathematical Proof Tutor
comments: arXiv admin note: substantial text overlap with arXiv:2506.08321. substantial text overlap with arXiv:2506.08321. substantial text overlap with arXiv:2506.08321. substantial text overlap with arXiv:2506.08321
summary: This paper considers the development of an AI-based provably-correct mathematical proof tutor. While Large Language Models (LLMs) allow seamless communication in natural language, they are error prone. Theorem provers such as Lean allow for provable-correctness, but these are hard for students to learn. We present a proof-of-concept system (LeanTutor) by combining the complementary strengths of LLMs and theorem provers. LeanTutor is composed of three modules: (i) an autoformalizer/proof-checker, (ii) a next-step generator, and (iii) a natural language feedback generator. To evaluate the system, we introduce PeanoBench, a dataset of 371 Peano Arithmetic proofs in human-written natural language and formal language, derived from the Natural Numbers Game.

title: UnWEIRDing Peer Review in Human Computer Interaction
comments: Accepted to CHI'26. Authors with (*) contributed equally to this work
summary: Peer review determines which scholarship is legitimized; however, review biases often disadvantage scholarship that diverges from the norm. Human-Computer Interaction (HCI) lacks a systemic inquiry into how such biases affect underrepresented Global South (GS) scholarship. To address this critical gap, we conducted four focus groups with 16 HCI researchers studying the GS. Participants reported experiencing reviews that confined them to development research, dismissed their theoretical contributions, and questioned situated knowledge from GS communities. Both as authors and reviewers, participants reported experiencing the epistemic burden of over-explaining why knowledge from GS communities matters. Further, they noted being tokenized as ``cultural experts'' when assigned to review papers and pointed out that the hidden curriculum of writing HCI papers often gatekeeps GS scholarship. Using epistemic oppression as a lens, we discuss how review practices marginalize GS scholarship and outline actionable strategies for nurturing equitable epistemological evaluation of HCI scholarship.
